newsitem.title: USA: Performance Food adopts holders rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Performance Food adopts holders rights plan.

text.p: Performance Food Group Co said Tuesday it adopted a shareholder rights plan and declared a dividend of one preferred stock purchase right for each outstanding share of its common stock.
The company said the rights plan was not adopted in response to any specific attempt to acquire control.
On May 30, 1997, company's shareholders will receive preferred stock purchase rights as a dividend at the rate of one right for each share of common stock.
The rights will expire in 10 years, the company said.
Each right would initially entitle its holder to purchase one-hundredth of a share of a new Series A Preferred Stock at an exercise price of $100 per right, the company said.

Each right would become exercisable only upon the occurrence of certain triggering events involving a non-board-approved acquisition of a significant ownership position in the company -- generally 20 percent of the outstanding common stock, but 10 percent in the event of a determination by the board, the company said.
